title: York, PA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

York is a city in PA with a population of 44,000. White Rose City with the York Revolution, the Colonial Complex, and a historic downtown. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.2.
